A '''Dantooinian sphere-fruit''' was a round type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Robes" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|All I'm going to say is, Jedi robes are NOT flattering. My rear end looks like a Dantooinian sphere-fruit in that thing.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Robes" />}}
Dantooinian sphere-fruits were first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. If a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] pursues a romance with the companion character [[Kira Carsen]], she will compare how her figure looks in a [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robe]] to a sphere-fruit in one of the messages she sends the player.<ref name="Robes" />
